notes: Artifacts are only offered for download when build verification finds a real file matching size and SHA-256 (local 'file') or a recorded 'url_verified_at' (external 'url'). Only a development-channel zip exists; there is no stable release.

releases.summary: Planned first stable release. Not yet published; no stable installer exists.
changelog: Tabular engine: CSV import, profiling, validation, leakage warnings, seeded splits
Candidates: baseline, linear and tree-based models with validation-only selection
Single-use test-set evaluation, SQLite experiment tracking, model export bundle
known_issues: No packaged installer has been built or verified
Windows is the only platform considered so far
GPU monitoring, hyperparameter search and pause/resume are not implemented

min_system.os: Windows 10/11 x64 (target; unverified on a built release)

releases.compatibility_notes: Running from source requires Python 3.12 with the packages in app/requirements.txt.

releases.summary: First development build of the tabular vertical slice (CSV classification and regression). Unsigned, for evaluation only.
changelog: Frozen Windows build of the PySide6 desktop app and the command-line interface
CSV import runs in a background thread; GUI display fixes (number formatting, warning colours)
Windowed app launcher (no console window) plus a separate console launcher for the CLI
Results screen bar chart, synthetic demo dataset button, export defaults to the workspace folder
Build verified by running EpochCLI.exe --selftest and confirming the GUI launcher stays running for 10 s on the build machine
known_issues: Not code-signed: Windows SmartScreen may warn
Tested only on the machine that built it; not tested on a clean Windows install
Exported model files are pickle-based; load only trusted bundles
No hyperparameter search, GPU support, group/temporal splits or pause/resume
The windowed launcher shows no error output; run EpochCLI.exe --selftest to diagnose problems

min_system.os: Windows 11 x64 (built and run on Windows 11; Windows 10 untested)

releases.compatibility_notes: Windows x64 only. Python is bundled; no separate install needed.

artifacts.name: Epoch-0.1.0.dev0-win-x64.zip
artifacts.install_notes: Extract the zip, then run Epoch\Epoch.exe for the app. Epoch\EpochCLI.exe is the command-line version (EpochCLI.exe --selftest checks the install).
